title: Squared paper for the bar chart
subject: Geography
unit: Summer 1: Rivers and the water cycle (Flow and One Planet, Our World)
source: Written for geography/y3 lesson 4 (Squared paper for the bar chart)
intro: Lesson 4: One planet: how people use and share water. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: How we use water
points: Farms and factories use the most

panels.title: Not everywhere has enough
points: Some walk far to fetch water

keywords.def: one of seven very large areas of land
one of five huge areas of salt water
a long time with too little rain
people who live and share things together

questions.q: Name two ways your family uses water.
Name one way to save water.
questions.a: Turn off the tap while brushing teeth, shorter showers, fix drips

questions.q: Core: Use your water tally (from home or the sample tally sheet) to make a bar chart of how your family uses water.
questions.a: A bar chart with labelled uses and correct bar heights

questions.q: Extend: Write three ways your family could conserve water.
questions.a: For example: fill a cup for teeth, a full washing machine only, a bowl for washing fruit

questions.q: Stretch: Why might countries sharing one river disagree?
questions.a: If one country takes more water upstream, less reaches people downstream

questions.q: A long time with too little rain is a:
questions.a: B) Drought. A drought means too little rain; a flood means too much water.

questions.q: Big question: is it fair? What should we do?
questions.a: No; we should use water carefully and share it, as Islam teaches
